title: PlatformEventEnvelopeV1
description: Canonical event envelope for all asynchronous messaging across the Enterprise AI Platform. Partition key in Kafka is tenantId.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this specific event occurrence (UUID v4).

eventType.description: Fully qualified dot-notated event name ending in version suffix (e.g. ticket.created.v1).

eventVersion.description: Major schema version number matching the eventType suffix.

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp in UTC when the event occurred in the domain.

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier. Strictly used as the Kafka message partition key.

aggregateId.description: Unique identifier of the domain aggregate root (e.g. ticket UUID).

aggregateVersion.description: Sequential optimistic locking version of the aggregate root for out-of-order detection.

correlationId.description: End-to-end trace correlation ID initiated at the API Gateway.

causationId.description: The eventId or commandId that directly caused this event to occur.

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent string (00-<trace_id>-<span_id>-<trace_flags>) for OTel distributed tracing.

producer.description: Name of the service that emitted the event (e.g. ticket-service).

payload.description: Event-specific domain payload validated against its specific event schema.
